description: Client-side JavaScript for homepage UI interactions, including sliders, animations, theme customization, and contact form handling.

methods.name: contactFormAjax
methods.description: Handles AJAX submission of contact form, resets form on success, and displays success message.

methods.name: demo
methods.description: Allows theme CSS and layout switching via cookies and dropdowns.

methods.name: sliders
methods.description: Initializes various Owl Carousel sliders for different page sections.

methods.name: menuSliding
methods.description: Handles dropdown menu slide animations based on window width.

methods.name: animations
methods.description: Sets up scroll-triggered animations for elements with data-animate attributes.

methods.name: animationsSlider
methods.description: Handles animations for carousel items during slide transitions.

methods.name: counters
methods.description: Initializes counter animations for elements with class 'counter'.

methods.name: pictureZoom
methods.description: Adjusts height of image containers to match image height for zoom effect.

methods.name: fullScreenContainer
methods.description: Sets container sizes to full window dimensions or fixed height.

methods.name: utils
methods.description: Provides utility functions for tooltips, clickable boxes, external links, and smooth scrolling.

methods.name: productDetailGallery
methods.description: Manages product image gallery with thumbnail switching and auto-rotation.
